extraction.notes: No qualifying summer camp or 2027 summer announcement was found in the supplied official pages or additional official-site searches. The programs page describes after-school programming, paid internships, school artist residencies, and school-based leadership programming. Additional pages checked included https://www.acsf.org/programs, https://www.acsf.org/irl, https://www.acsf.org/irl-catalog, and https://www.acsf.org/events. The programs and REAP overview pages returned no readable body text when opened; the programs page was available through official search results. The summer camp mentioned in Ona Armstrong's artist biography is her separately operated offering, not an ACSF program.
